## Referenced by Quarto

With the version v1.1.1, [`quarto-ieee`] is now available on the [quarto-listing] of [quarto-extensions].
Most of the [quarto-journal] requirements have been verified.

This release also support both ![Quarto-1.3](https://img.shields.io/badge/quarto-1.3-blue?label=quarto) and ![Quarto-1.4](https://img.shields.io/badge/quarto-1.4-blue?label=quarto).

You can access a local evaluation of the [`quarto-ieee`] template [in PDF](https://github.com/dfolio/quarto-ieee/blob/main/template.pdf) as well as  [in HTML](https://htmlpreview.github.io/?https://github.com/dfolio/quarto-ieee/blob/master/template.html).
